text: For message-view regression tests, observe the second tab after switching to it and wait for a rendering frame before inspecting displayed counts. Await actual database state changes with TestUtils.waitForCondition. The original500ms sleep in 264 is historical. The current accepted test uses condition waits and requestAnimationFrame. Scope: cross-tab folder-display tests. No tests run in this study.
title: Observe background-tab state and wait for its rendering boundary
